title: Shared input and transitive affected targets
expected: A shared input change affects API and web; an API-only change leaves web unaffected.
Unknown undeclared dependencies force a conservative full rebuild.

cases.name: shared-change
cases.expect: API and web tests/actions are affected.

cases.name: api-change
cases.expect: API changes; unrelated web action remains reusable.

cases.name: declared-targets
cases.change: From variants/targets, commit a local Git baseline, then edit api/src/greeting.mjs or shared/src/greeting.mjs.
cases.expect: API-only selects api and its shared prerequisite; shared change selects shared, api and web; unused stays excluded. No changes yields an empty inspected bundle.

limitations: Original single-project action-cache reuse remains pending. The declared-target variation has local no-change CLI proof and registered selective captured-build checks; those CI results remain pending.
Native workspace member-level impact and policy-aware affected selection remain unfinished.
